  1. Brandywine Raspberry. 

Its chief characteristics are 1st. Perfect hardiness of plant, which does not require any winter protection. 2d. Great productiveness, being one of the best fruiters known 3d. Firmness of fruit, which admits of shipping, it long distances in perfect condition 4th. and important, the fruit is of excellent quality. “1.50 [X] doz” in pencil. Labeled “D.M. Dewey’s Series, Colored from Nature. American Fruits and Flowers”


  1. Gregg Raspberry. 

(A New Black Cap)

Excelling all other varieties in size, and flavor and productiveness, and destined to supercede the Mammoth Cluster. Has always been voted the highest rank by Horticultural Societies wherever exhibited. A remarkable strong, robust grower, producing large, strong canes and yielding from ¼ to ½ more fruit than other varieties. “1.50 [X] doz” in pencil. Labeled “D.M. Dewey’s Series, Colored from Nature. American Fruits and Flowers.”


  1. Black Naples. 

The Black Naples is a beautiful fruit, the finest and largest of all Black Currants. Very productive. “2.00 [X] doz” in pencil. Labeled “D.M. Dewey’s Series, Colored from Nature. American Fruits and Flowers.”


  1. White Grape. 

Very large, mild and excellent. The best table variety. “2.00 [X] doz” in pencil. Labeled “D.M. Dewey’s Series, Colored from Nature. American Fruits and Flowers.”


  1. CHERRY CURRANT.

A strong-growing variety., with stout, erect short-jointed shoots. Leaves large, thick and dark green. Not any more productive than other currants, but a valuable one for market on account of its size. Fruit of the very largest size; bunches short; berries deep red, and rather more acid than Red Dutch. “2.00 [X] doz” in pencil. Labeled “D.M. Dewey’s Series, Colored from Nature. American Fruits and Flowers.”


  1. Paeonia - - Delachii.

“50” in pencil. Labeled “D.M. Dewey’s Series, Colored from Nature. American Fruits and Flowers.”


  1. Paeonia - - Humeii. 

“50” in pencil. Labeled “D.M. Dewey’s Series, Colored from Nature. American Fruits and Flowers.”


  1. Weigelia Rosea. 

Beautiful, hardy shrub. Blooms in May. Dewey’s Medium Series, Colored from Nature. “75” in pencil. Labeled “Dewey’s Medium Series, Colored from Nature.”


  1. Spiera Revesii, 

A charming shrub, with narrow pointed leaves, and large round clusters of white flowers, that cover the whole plant. Blooms in May. “50” in pencil. Labeled “D.M. Dewey’s Series, Colored from Nature. American Fruits and Flowers.”


  1. PRUNUS TRILOBATA. 

A highly interesting and desirable addition to hardy shrubs flowers semi-double, of a delicate pink, thickly set on long slender branches. 


  1. Hydrangea Paniculata Grandiflora. 

(One-half size.)

Very fine flowering shrub. Grows eight to ten feet high.”75” in pencil. Labeled “D.M. Dewey’s Series, Colored from Nature. American Fruits and Flowers.”


  1. Deutzia Gracilis. 

A charming species introduced from Japan, flowers pure white. Fine for pot culture as it flowers freely at a low temperature in winter. “75” in pencil. Labeled “D.M. Dewey’s Series, Colored from Nature. American Fruits and Flowers.”


  1. La France. 

Has all the delicacy of appearance, and exquisiteness of purpose of the best Tea Roses, combined with the hardiness of the Hybrid Perpetual. An almost constant bloomer. “1.00” in pencil. Labeled “Dewey’s Medium Series, Colored from Nature.”


  1. BALTIMORE BELLE. 

Hardy Summer climbing class. Vigorous. “75” in pencil. Labeled “D.M. Dewey’s Series, Colored from Nature. American Fruits and Flowers.”


  1. Queen of the Prairies. 

A beautiful climber; bright rosy red, frequently with  a white stripe; large, compact and globular. “75” in pencil. Labeled “D.M. Dewey’s Series, Colored from Nature. American Fruits and Flowers.”


  1. John Hopper. 

Hybrid Perpetual. Large and full. One of the finest. “75” in pencil. Labeled “D.M. Dewey’s Series, Colored from Nature. American Fruits and Flowers.”


  1. Glory of Mosses. 

“1.00” in pencil. Labeled “D.M. Dewey’s Series, Colored from Nature. American Fruits and Flowers.”


  1. Imperial Cut Leaved Alder. 

It is a stately tree, of graceful slender growth, with large foliage. Perfectly hardy. Unsurpassed as a lawn tree. “1.50” in pencil. Labeled “D.M. Dewey’s Series, Colored from Nature. American Fruits and Flowers.”


  1. MOUNTAIN ASH. 

A deserved and general favorite. Blooms profusely in May, with white flowers followed by bunches of round scarlet berries in Autumn which hang during the greater part of WinTer. Highly ornamental and desirable for small grounds and parks. 


  1. HORSE-CHESTNUT- - - while flowering. 

A hardy, healthy tree, of rapid growth, covered in June with magnificent spikes of flowers. “1.00” in pencil. Labeled “D.M. Dewey’s Series, Colored from Nature. American Fruits and Flowers.”


  1. PURPLE LEAVED BEECH.

An elegant and vigorous tree; grows from 40 to 50 feet high; foliage in spring deep purple, in summer changes to crimson, in fall to a dull purplish green. Close up of individual leaf with “LEAF ¼ IN SIZE” along margin. “2.50” in pencil.


  1. Kilmarnock Weeping Willow- - - Caprea Pendula. 

A hardy and beautiful tree for lawns; it forms without any trimming, a very graceful tree, with glossy foliage; perfect umbrella head in form. Thrives well in all soils. “1.25” in pencil. Labeled “D.M. Dewey’s Series, Colored from Nature. American Fruits and Flowers.”

 

  1. CUT LLEAVED WEEPING BIRCH.

(PENDULA LACINIATA.) 

One of the most popular, beautiful, and long lived of all the weeping, or pendulous trees; vigorous in growth, with graceful drooping branches, silvery white…“1.50” in pencil. 


  1. IRISH, SWEDISH, OR ENGLISH JUNIPER

Handsome Evergreens of compact growth. Very ornamental. These three vary but slightly “50” in faint pencil. Labeled “D.M. Dewey’s Series, Colored from Nature. American Fruits and Flowers.”


  1. NORWAY SPRUCE

(ABIES EXCELSA.)

A lofty, elegant evergreen tree. Branches droop when the tree attains the height of fifteen or twenty feet. “18-24’’- 50, 2-3 ft 1.00” in pencil. 


  1. AUSTRIAN OR BLACK PINE. 

VALUABLE ROBUST AND HARDY RAPID GROWER. “1.00” in pencil. Labeled “Dewey’s Pocket Series.Copyright secured. Colored from nature.”
